title: what's the best AI dev studio for solo development with an unlimited plan
author: kagaAkagi1
selftext: I have been trying to find a good AI development tool to work on games with but have run into some issues.  I have some coding experience but not enough to work on an entire project by my self and AI has really unlocked my ability to express my self and to create games.   the problem I have is most platforms are monetizing using a credits system where X$ gets you Y credits and each prompt costs Z Credits.  The problem is I burn through these credits extremely quickly.   I have tried rosebud ai and emergent but I can burn through my monthly credits in less than a day.  Is their any AI development platforms that offer an unlimited plan? (preferably an unlimited plan that doesnt cost an arm and a leg)

comments.author: Afraid-Act424
comments.body: Try Claude Code + MCP. It’s engine-agnostic (works with Unity, Godot, etc.) and bypasses the restrictive credit systems of tools like Rosebud. It gives you much more freedom for solo game dev by working directly within your own project environment.

comments.author: angrylittledev
comments.body: Nothing is "unlimited" currently, they are all in it for the profit, servers ain't free nor cheap to maintain. Some plans give you more than others but overall from personal experience in making 5 games so far, Claude is the best by far, Opus models, but, big but, they burn through tokens super fast. But it will get you what you need with minimum mistakes or fixes.

replies.author: Kamalen
replies.body:
>Nothing is "unlimited" currently, they are all in it for the profit, servers ain't free nor cheap to maintain.

Not only that, but limitations are quickly shrinking on subscriptions. It probably won't be long before the only possible usage of cloud model will be through pay-per-use.

People wanting serious use should prepare themselves for those rising costs, or to own capable enough hardware for light models.

replies.author: kagaAkagi1
replies.body: this is so much better than what i was using, i love how this AI asks questions to make sure its doing things right as well, ty

comments.author: Emergency_Mastodon56
comments.body: Check out Logicsmith.dev if you want to work in unreal with blueprints :)

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body: $20/month claude or codex plan and whichever you like more push to 5x plan. Let's you run 10+ hour days without stops.

comments.author: Olmeca_Gold
comments.body: Use claude code or codex. Develop in three.js, phaser.js or at least Godot.

comments.author: Weak_Sugar_5757
comments.body: I use Google's gemini pro and it's excellent, but I use it only for help with the code and support for using unity's tools. I still need to create and do all the other things myself.

comments.author: meaw_meaw123
comments.body: most game-focused ai tools like rosebud hit that credit wall fast, yeah. if you have some coding chops already, pairing a local model setup with something like godot can stretch your budget since you're only paying for compute. for a hosted option, Zencoder has plans that wont bleed you dry on credits.
